column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 3 piece B's cascade-terminate lease-mirror regression test: it opens a *PostgresStore directly via newRunTestStore (testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres)), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases is PostgreSQL-only, same scoping as migration-018-columns.tsv's five tests, so it has no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so it skips here.
same test, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so it skips here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
